University of Sydney researchers are entitled to fully-subsidised access to Pawsey facilities through the Sydney Scheme. Access to Pawsey systems will be an ongoing feature of the [Sydney Research Cloud](https://intranet.sydney.edu.au/research-support/managing-research/facilities-and-tools/sydney-research-cloud.html) initiative. 

:::{.callout-note}
## Attention researchers
Please see the [University of Sydney Research Computing documentation](https://sydneyuni.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/RC/pages/3448733944/NCI-Sydney+Scheme) for details on how to access Pawsey Setonix.
:::

For details about logging on to Setonix once your Pawsey project is set up, please see [Logging on](#notebooks/login.qmd).
